title: 第5章 不跑步也开除不了，光明女神蝶
slug: 斗罗冬儿重生我不是唐舞桐
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

跑了二十多圈之后，王冬儿停了下来。

她走到旁边的草地上，一屁股坐了下去。

霍雨浩跑出去十几步才发现身边少了个人。

他回头一看，王冬儿正盘腿坐在草坪上，仰头看天，一副事不关己的模样。

“王冬。”他急忙跑回来，伸手去拉她。

“你在干什么？快起来！”

“不跑了。”王冬儿拍了拍身边的草地。

“你也坐。”

“坐什么坐，周老师说了，跑不完会被开除的。”

“放心吧，不会的。”王冬儿的语气十分笃定。

“不行，我得继续跑，我不想被开除。”

“那你自己跑吧，反正我是跑不动了。”

王冬儿当然还能跑，但她觉得今天的运动量已经差不多了。

霍雨浩犹豫了一下，还是继续跑起来。

对于周漪的这种教学方法，王冬儿并不认同。

对于身体比较弱的魂师，一来直接跑一百圈，简直是要他们的命。

万一伤了根基，以后补都补不回来。

修炼还是得循序渐进。

她坐在草坪上看着霍雨浩一圈一圈的跑。

时间还有五分钟，剩下十圈霍雨浩无论如何也跑不完了。

霍雨浩的眼眶红了，他不想被开除。好不容易才进入史莱克学院，不想就这样离开。

他要好好的修炼，为妈妈报仇，让所有欺负他们母子的人付出代价的。

霍雨浩的腿像灌了铅，每一步都沉重得像在泥沼里跋涉。

但他还是在跑，咬着牙，低着头，像一只和暴风雨对抗的孤帆。

王冬儿站在草地上，看着他的背影。

傻小子。

她深吸一口气，背后亮起了一片光。

那是一对翅膀，一对极为漂亮的翅膀。

光明女神蝶。

这是属于王冬儿自己的武魂。

翅膀轻轻一振，王冬儿朝着那个跌跌撞撞奔跑的身影飞过去。

霍雨浩忽然觉得脚下一轻。

一股柔和的力量托住了他的腰，把他整个人从地面提了起来。

他还没来得及反应，后背就贴上了一个温热的身体。

“别动。”王冬儿的声音在耳边响起。

“抓紧我。”

她的手臂穿过他的腋下，牢牢扣住了他的胸口。

光明女神蝶的翅膀在他们身后完全展开，在夕阳下折射出流水般的光泽。

他偏过头，看见的是王冬儿的侧脸。

风吹乱了她的头发，她的睫毛很长，在风里微微颤动。背后的翅膀洒下大片大片的光斑，那些光落在她的发丝上，像是碎了一地的星星。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

After running more than twenty laps, Wang Donger stopped.

She walked to the grass nearby and sat down.

Huo Yuhao ran out for more than ten steps before he realized that there was someone missing beside him.

He looked back and saw Wang Donger sitting cross-legged on the lawn, looking up at the sky, as if it had nothing to do with him.

"Wang Dong." He hurried back and reached out to pull her.

"What are you doing? Get up!"

"Don't run away." Wang Dong'er patted the grass beside him.

"You sit down too."

"Where to sit? Teacher Zhou said, if you don't finish running, you will be expelled."

"Don't worry, it won't happen." Wang Donger's tone was very firm.

"No, I have to keep running. I don't want to get fired."

"Then you can run away by yourself. I can't run anymore anyway."

Of course Wang Donger can still run, but she feels that the amount of exercise today is almost enough.

Huo Yuhao hesitated for a moment, then continued running.

Wang Donger did not agree with Zhou Yi's teaching method.

For the weaker soul masters, running a hundred laps would literally kill them.

If the foundation is damaged, it cannot be repaired later.

Cultivation still needs to be done step by step.

She sat on the lawn and watched Huo Yuhao running around in circles.

There were still five minutes left, and Huo Yuhao couldn't finish the remaining ten laps no matter what.

Huo Yuhao's eyes were red, he didn't want to be fired.It took a lot of effort to enter Shrek Academy, and I didn’t want to leave like this.

He wants to practice hard, avenge his mother, and make all those who bully their mother and son pay the price.

Huo Yuhao's legs felt like they were filled with lead, and every step was as heavy as trudging through a mire.

But he was still running, gritting his teeth and lowering his head, like a lone sail fighting against the storm.

Wang Donger stood on the grass and looked at his back.

Silly boy.

She took a deep breath, and a light lit up behind her.

It was a pair of wings, a pair of extremely beautiful wings.

Light goddess butterfly.

This is Wang Donger's own martial spirit.

With a slight flutter of wings, Wang Dong'er flew towards the stumbling figure.

Huo Yuhao suddenly felt a lightness on his feet.

A gentle force held his waist and lifted him off the ground.

Before he could react, a warm body pressed against his back.

"Don't move." Wang Dong'er's voice rang in her ears.

"Hold on to me."

She put her arms through his armpits and clasped his chest firmly.

The wings of the goddess of light butterfly were fully unfolded behind them, reflecting the luster of flowing water in the setting sun.

He turned his head and saw Wang Donger's side face.

The wind messed up her hair, and her eyelashes were very long and trembling slightly in the wind.The wings on her back cast large patches of light, and the light fell on her hair, like stars shattered on the ground.
